batch: Captain Zheren, Kellak, and Vergalid’s End
coverage_limits: Inherited Nurtha and Goru lockouts and a conflicting prior final lockout were checked offline. A second native raid was not run.
The natural expiry consequences of Dooming Exile and Breed of Corruption were not observed. The native cure witness was Breed of Corruption.
The native repaired shrine gate witness covers the inbound crossing. The reverse crossing and rejection boundaries were covered in focused offline checks.

Scoped development assistance included existing fixture invulnerability, a test weapon for some real attacks, and public travel staging to keep the same occurrence and earned state. One witness temporarily ran without invulnerability for the actual curse and cure. Encounter kills, task progression, chest rolls and loot used the game’s normal paths.

historical_reconstruction: Kellak uses six to 24 players and average level 75. Historical task metadata and a recorded six-person route support it. Other contemporary accounts state 18 present, and the timing of that rule change is unresolved.

Vergalid’s End uses six to 54 players. Six must be present in Sunderock for the request, and six nearby in the lair to awaken Vergalid. NPC statistics, some encounter timings and spawn positions, some appearances, the exile pit boundary, and precise loot weights are reconstructed.

Nurtha and Vergalid each use one guaranteed rune plus one optional rune roll. The correction was verified against actual loot logic and isolated MariaDB. The first Nurtha kill preceded the fix, so the native corrected loot witness is Vergalid’s chest.
native_verification: The requester earned all four original Zheren tasks. The run used the original public entrance and return, both directions of the physical lift, and the final report to Zheren.

All six entered Kellak through the original switch. Kellak cast during combat, spawned three offspring at 45%, and died to an actual player attack. A real corpse item was recovered, and the archive and 36-hour replay timer were verified for all six.

The earned roster requested and entered Vergalid’s End at the original switch. The Rogue used normal Sense and Disarm to disarm an old chest and a moving contraption. Nurtha’s three machines, actual victory, corpse loot and 84-hour lockout were verified.
The original Goru challenge started the undead waves. The raid killed 35 undead, observed reinforcement at half health, defeated Goru, collected real corpse loot, and earned the 60-hour lockout.

All six shrine protectors were defeated. The original inner gate admitted the raid after its binding was corrected. Vergalid awakened for six nearby members. A real Breed of Corruption was cleared by destroying a real infused crystal while the curse was active.

Vergalid died to an actual attack. All six final completion rows and the 84-hour Vergalid lockout were verified. The native chest yielded two gear items and one Glowing Obsidian Rune after the corrected loot roll.
Native Hail with the normal client key was verified at Kazzar. The updated exact-name dialogue branch for Nurtha and Goru was exercised offline, with native Goru challenge verified in the live run.
